tips.text: Run Infested Salvage solo; decryption slows with every extra squad member.
Keep running Infested Salvage solo for the parts; every extra squad member slows decryption.
Extract and restart after round 4; deeper rounds scale harder with the same drop odds.
Bring Nekros, Khora, Hydroid, Ivara, Atlas or a Chesa Kubrow to raise Antiserum Charge drops.
Kill enemies close to the Vaporizers; charges despawn quickly and far AoE kills drop charges you cannot reach.
Keep circling and top up each Vaporizer every pass instead of waiting for its bubble to shrink.
Octavia is a low-attention solo pick; Mallet and Resonator make the Infested kill themselves while you carry charges.
Research the Antiserum Injector in your clan dojo to restore armor from the Gear menu without spending a carried charge.
Switch to Operator between Vaporizers if your armor is stripped; the corrosive air does not hurt it.
Kill Ancient Disruptors fast; they zero your energy and keep it there.
Do The Glast Gambit once credit wagers no longer matter; the quest will wait and a lost wager is burned.
If you run out of credits mid-quest, set another quest active in the Codex to play normal Index matches and win them back.
Play Match 4 without Specters; they bank points on their own and can push you past the 20-point margin.
Start all three part builds together so the frame build can begin sooner.
Nobody regrets the destination; Nidus is called one of the best frames, and the regret is running the farm in a public squad.
Players who got parts in Rotation A or B report far fewer runs than the old stories of 27 to 60 runs for a part.
